name: neon-snake-analytics-functions
description: Analytics collection backend for Neon Snake, run on the Firebase Local Emulator Suite.

scripts.test: npm run sync-shared && vitest run --dir src
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore --project demo-neon-snake "vitest run --dir test"
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-neon-snake
